title: route_hash over hop ADDRESSES (16B): C tunnel_auth.c + lichen/tests/tunnel_auth migration
description: Spec changed (5muj): 06-security.md §8.11 route_hash now hashes full 16-byte hop ADDRESSES, not 8-byte IIDs. lichen/subsys/lichen/gateway/tunnel_auth.c: lichen_tunnel_route_hash(crypto, route_iids, route_hops, out) takes route_iids (8-byte hops); the header documents route_iids at tunnel_auth.h:126-143. Migrate the hop parameter to 16-byte addresses (rename route_iids -> route_addrs; hash hop[16]); the host test lichen/tests/tunnel_auth/src/main.c and gen_vectors.py consume the shared corpus. COORDINATE with the shared-vector child (tunnel_authorization.json regen). Discovered-from 5muj.
